desc: This All-American rifle directly answers the requests of the American consumer with the additions to the already dependable platform of a bulged/forged front trunnion, enhanced safety and bolt hold open, optics rail, cleaning rod, and bayonet lug, all based on a 1.5mm stamped receiver, and complemented with high quality American maple furniture. This new flagship rifle of Century Arms is truly the culmination of American engineering at its finest!
